title: Purchase Option
description: One way to buy a variant: once, as a subscription, on pre-order. The Business enumerates the options it sells; the Platform selects one by `id`. An option modifies how the line it is selected on is bought — its price now — and never adds, removes, or changes other lines. The recurring orders an option entails, where it has them, are stated by a subscription policy that targets the option, and the line once it is selected.

id.description: Opaque identifier for this option, sent back as `selected_purchase_option_id`. Stable for as long as the option is offered; a Platform treats it as indivisible and derives nothing from it.

title.description: Short label that distinguishes this option from its siblings (e.g. 'One-time', 'Subscribe & save 15%', 'Pre-order').

description.description: Supplementary buyer-facing context for the title (e.g. 'Cancel anytime', 'Ships in March'). Directly renderable; MUST NOT repeat the title. Display content, not the authoritative statement of an obligation: recurring orders are stated by the subscription policy that targets the option.

price.description: What one unit costs in the current purchase under this option, after any discount or fixed pricing the option defines and before quantity, taxes, discounts, fees, and fulfillment. `0` means the current purchase is genuinely free; it never means a non-zero amount is merely collected later — a free trial is a first order at full price whose payment a payment term defers. Recurring orders are excluded; a subscription policy targeting the option states them.

list_price.description: Reference price this option's `price` is a saving against, for strikethrough display and a derivable saving, mirroring `variant.list_price`: for a subscribe-and-save option, the one-time price. Absent when there is nothing to compare.
